model: T9800 Series Touch Screen Fan Coil Thermostat (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Two- and four-pipe fan coils (relay or 0-10 VDC valves, three-speed or ECM fans), fan coils with floor heating or TiO2/ESP, water source heat pumps, boilers and a basic AHU application, using the T9800 touch screen thermostat.
summary: The T9800 is a touch screen fan coil thermostat with BACnet MS/TP. One points table covers all three models; which objects exist depends on the model and on the application code (0-18) set in the thermostat, and the table marks each object as always present, absent, or present only for listed apps. The list covers the relays and analog outputs, room temperature and humidity, setpoints, mode, fan speed, occupancy, enable, error code and running status.
notes: Objects from Table 3 on pages 6-9 of Technical Bulletin Rev 1.4. Point descriptions on pages 9-11 were used for the short descriptions.
The table has no access column. Access is inferred: inputs and status values (ZN-T, ZN-H, OCC-S, ERROR, STATUS) read-only, outputs commandable, the other values writable.

Availability per model is in each description as TF20 / TF21 / TB21 (model columns T9800-TF20-9JS0, -TF21-9JS0, -TB21-9JS0). App codes: 0 2-pipe, 1 4-pipe, 2 2-pipe 3-wire valve, 3 2-pipe with floor heater, 4 2-pipe with TiO2/ESP, 5 water source heat pump, 6 boiler, 7-8 modulating 2/4-pipe, 9-17 ECM fan variants, 18 AHU.
Multistate state text is listed in the order printed; the table gives no state numbers.

source.title: T9800 series BACnet MS/TP Networked Thermostat Controller Technical Bulletin

integration.summary: Set a valid MAC address and baud rate at the thermostat, discover it on the BACnet MS/TP trunk, then command UNIT-EN, MODE, FAN-MODE and the setpoint ZNT-SP, and use OCC-OVRD for occupancy. Read ZN-T, STATUS and ERROR.

minimum_points.name: MODE
minimum_points.why: Mode: Heat, Cool, Fan Only or Auto

minimum_points.name: FAN-MODE
minimum_points.why: Fan speed: low, med, high or auto

minimum_points.name: ERROR
minimum_points.why: Error code (sensor faults, dew point, filter)

integration.enable: UNIT-EN (MV 1314) enables or shuts down the unit. OCC-OVRD (MV 1317) forces Occupied or Unoccupied; No Override leaves occupancy to the thermostat.
integration.remote_sensors: The guide lists a remote temperature sensor input (R-ZNT, AI 1003) but no BAS-written temperature object.
setup: MS/TP MAC address 6 to 128; the factory value 128 is not valid for a master, so set the MAC before connecting.
Baud rate default is Auto; fixed choices are 9600, 19200, 38400 and 76800.
Enter the setting menu with the fan coil switched off by holding the fan key together with a second key (named in the guide) for 5 seconds; MAC is setting 1 and baud rate setting 14.
No on-board end-of-line termination; fit terminators on the first and last devices.
The points table lists the device object as DEV-1.
gotchas: Many objects only exist for certain models and application codes; check the app code set at the thermostat before mapping.
PB, KI and SMPL-TM are the tuning values (proportional band, integral, control period) for modulating valve control.
